children: Red Robin appointed Tiffany Dutton as Chief Accounting Officer, effective September 21, 2026, reporting to Chief Financial Officer Mark Graff.
Chief Accounting Officer; principal accounting officer

Age 46; served as accounting consultant since Feb 2022 and interim Chief Accountant at Red Robin since Oct 2025; prior roles include SVP & Principal Accounting Officer at Capital Senior Living (Dec 2020–Feb 2022), VP Accounting & Financial Reporting (Jan–Dec 2020); earlier roles at Adeptus Health, RealPage, Pier 1; began career at Ernst & Young; CPA.
